verdict.rationale: Role-based control over who can view or edit APIs is a fair question for an API management platform, but the evidence pack does not document management-plane roles or permissions. Nearby items do not establish the capability. The Terraform provider only names "Teams" without describing permissions. Event Hooks only show that an "Admins" entity exists. The ACL plugin governs API consumer traffic, not who can edit configuration. Dev Portal public/private visibility controls developer access to published docs, not edit rights.
